text:
Nina - Marketing: quick thread to lock hero lines & webinar CTA routing for the three deployment pages. aiming to ship new copy + form by Friday. thoughts? :clock4:
Diego - Growth: need one consistent CTA funnel for webinar signups. prefer 'See it running' as primary. then segment leads by company_tier + infra_needs.
Priya - Product: For Dedicated page let's lead with SLO language: "Dedicated capacity, enforced latency SLOs." keep it tight.
Omar - Design: for Private page avoid cloud motif. use 'air-gapped' or 'on-prem' visual cues. also say no hero carousels, single strong stat.
Lena - Content: draft hero options (short): Hosted: 'Hosted API — instant access, low-latency.' Dedicated: 'Dedicated capacity — predictable throughput.' Private: 'Private deploys — VPC & on-prem.' Want a one-line subhead about tuning?
Nina - Marketing: yes include a 6-8 word subhead that hints at batching/caching/quantization. Luca? (meant Omar)
Omar - Design: subhead placement below CTA works. we'll reserve space for a 1-line benchmark chip.
Diego - Growth: segmentation rule proposal: if company_tier == 'Enterprise' OR infra_needs contains 'VPC' -> route to AE; else -> marketing nurture. add revenue estimate if provided > $50k ARR -> AE.
FormBot: New form created: https://forms.example.com/redwood-launch-apr. Fields: company_name, company_tier, infra_needs, estimated_annual_spend.
Priya - Product: recommend capturing 'expected qps' and 'model_size' as optional fields so Integrations team can prep config templates.
Lena - Content: alternate hero phrasing to avoid repetition across pages: Hosted: 'Start with our hosted API — production-ready.' Dedicated: 'Reserve GPUs for steady production.' Private: 'Run inference where your data lives.'
Nina - Marketing: CTA pairing: primary = 'See it running' (all pages), secondary = 'Start trial' (Hosted/Dedicated only), tertiary on Private = 'Contact sales'.
Diego - Growth: Zapier -> SFDC mapping draft: 
```
source: website
page: {{page_slug}}
company_tier: {{company_tier}}
infra_needs: {{infra_needs}}
est_annual_spend: {{estimated_annual_spend}}
```
routing: if company_tier == Enterprise OR infra_needs contains "VPC" OR est_annual_spend >= 50000 -> owner=AE; else owner=SDR.
Omar - Design: benchmarking chip suggestion per-page: Hosted hero chip: 'p95 token latency: ~80ms' Dedicated: 'Sustained throughput: 200 tokens/s per GPU' Private: 'Customizable SLOs & network isolation'. keep them short.
Lena - Content: microcopy under hero: 'Production inference controls — batching, cache, routing, quantization.'
Nina - Marketing: testing plan: A/B test CTA text on Hosted page week1 (See it running vs Watch demo). track conversion + lead quality.
Priya - Product: timeline check: copy freeze Wednesday EOD, design handoff Thursday morning, dev deploy Friday.
Diego - Growth: confirm I'll update Zapier mapping and add revenue bucket parsing.
FormBot: Reminder set for Wed 17:00 "Copy freeze for tri pages".
Nina - Marketing: sweet. please drop final snippets here and I'll assemble the CMS csv for import. thanks! :white_check_mark:
